name: TEXFMT_RGB565
meaning: g_texRequestedFormat 0 accepts rBits 5 / gBits 6; format 0 copies 16-bit pixels unchanged

name: TEXFMT_ARGB1555
meaning: 1 accepts 5/5 bits with an alpha mask; format 1 repacks 565 -> 1555

name: TEXFMT_ARGB4444
meaning: 2 accepts 4/4 bits with an alpha mask; format 2 repacks to 4444 (HoleFX mask texture doc: format-2 = ARGB4444)
